out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed dish machine dispensing 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC elected to discontinue use of dish machine until repair is made and set up 3 compartment sink during inspection to wash dishes.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: stove, fryers, refrigerators in facility.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please increase cleaning frequency of nonfood contact surfaces.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink near the 3 compartment sink being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed the concentration of chlorine in the chemical dish machine at 0ppm
violations.corrective_action: PIC set up the 3 compartment sink. PIC will provide an invoice once the machine has been serviced.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed concentration of chlorine in the chemical dish machine at 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC WILL PROVIDE AN INVOICE ONCE THE DISH MACHINE HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the back kitchen area handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGER TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the MEN’S RESTROOM hand sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGER TO POST A SIGN IN THE MEN’S RESTROOM BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed all types of chemicals stored on shelving units above the 3-vat sink or on the work table used for baking.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO STORE ALL CHEMICALS BELOW AND SEPARATED FROM FOOD PREP AREAS AND DISH WASHING AREAS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: 1) 3DOOR PREP TOP REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE A WORKING REFRIGERATOR THERMOMETER INSIDE THE 3DOOR PREP UNIT BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed several boxes of single service items stored in direct contact with the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT NOTHING SHOULD BE IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE FLOOR. PROVIDE MORE NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS FOR PROPER STORAGE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) INSIDE REFRIGERATORS AND FREEZERS TO INCLUDE THE FLOORS, 2) AREAS OF THE COOK LINE TO INCLUDE EXTERIORS OF THE GRILL, FRYERS, OVEN, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PERFORM A DEEP CLEANING TO REMOVE BUILT UP GREASE, FOOD SPLATTER, FOOD DEBRIS, DUST, ETC. ENSURE CLEANING IS DONE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed no physical air gap at the sanitize basin of the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE MANAGER AND FIRE CHIEF. EHS EMAILED DIAGRAMS SHOWING PROPER PLUMBING FOR WHENEVER A LEAK OR REPAIR IS NEEDED TO THE PIPES AND/OR A RENOVATION IS COMPLETED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE MANAGER RINSING OUT THE MOP(S) AND HANGING THEM FOR AIR DRYING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Ceiling panels in the dry storage area and restrooms used by employees are not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS DISCUSSED VINYL COATED, ACOUSTICAL LAY-IN CEILING PANELS WITH THE MANAGER AND FIRE CHIEF. ENSURE CORRECTION WHEN A REPAIR OR LEAK OR RENOVATION OCCURS. ANNANDALE VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPT (Inspection Date: 12/12/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the WALL in the water heater closet is not maintained in good repair. Observed small gaps in the ceiling panels where electrical or plumbing is located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE MANAGER AND FIRE CHIEF REPAIRING THE WALL AND CEILING PANELS TO PREVENT POSSIBLE ENTRY OF PESTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls in the baking area are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CLEAN THE WALLS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
